description: This trail will take to you to Wells Gray Provincial National Park and into the Trophy Mountains
directions: From Clearwater on Yellowhead Hwy 5, take Clearwater Valley Road north for 11km towards Wells Gray Park. Near Spahats Park, turn right onto Spahats Creek Forest Service Rd./Road 80 and proceed up steep & rough road for 4.2km. Stay left, following the signs for Trophy Mtn Meadows for the last 8.7km to the parking area and trailhead.
title: Trophy Mountain Tour
